note: 目标正文和全部FAQ核读；具体原句：painting Saint John the Baptist and Saint John the Evangelist in grey convincing enough to read as statues standing in stone niches。逐句判断：目标1432灰阶两圣人支持塑像效果；删tone排除geometry的伪二分，不声称grisaille无空间构造。

目标正文和全部FAQ核读；具体原句：a pin driven into the canvas at the vanishing point, with a chalked string tied to it and snapped against the surface。逐句判断：目标Liedtke解释pinhole+chalkstring是一个物证读法；保留may/contested，免lens是该方法不需而非排除Vermeer其他器具。
目标正文和全部FAQ核读；具体原句：Dow had three elements.。逐句判断：目标三条不同旧体系和现代seven中space支持具体课堂词汇对照；不据archive1968推全球首创。
